_comment_top: Brain hook + MCP additions to merge into ~/.claude/settings.json. The arrays MUST be merged additively — preserve any existing entries (Corridor, kjell, tmux, etc.). DO NOT replace whole arrays.
_comment_hooks: PreToolUse: sacred-paths guard. PreCompact + SessionEnd: enqueue.sh records a durable event in ~/brain/.brain/state/capture-queue.jsonl; the brain-capture worker (launchd or manual) drains it and dispatches the headless delta classifier. enqueue.sh is fast and cannot block the hook — durability of the trigger is what matters; processing is async.
